title: Ukraine drone attacks kill three, injure 14 in Russia’s Belgorod region
summary_full: A drone strike carried out by Ukrainian forces hit Belgorod, leading to two confirmed deaths and injuring at least 13 people. Local officials highlighted significant destruction to housing, vehicles, and local infrastructure. Additionally, a nearby village reported another fatality and injuries stemming from the ongoing hostilities. These events underscore the ongoing violence escalating along the Russia-Ukraine border, and tensions continue to mount in the region.
